name: Adpend USDC (adpUSDC)

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

steps.what: owner() on the contract: the holder
eth_getCode on the holder: 0x means a plain key
eth_getTransactionCount on the holder: how many transactions this key has sent (67 at the read)

independent_read_reproduce.curl:
# owner() on the contract: the holder
curl -s -X POST https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_call","params":[{"to":"0x55555815a5595991c3a0ff119b59aef6c8b55555","data":"0x8da5cb5b"},"0x18f5995"]}'
# eth_getCode on the holder: 0x means a plain key
curl -s -X POST https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_getCode","params":["<holder>","latest"]}'
# eth_getTransactionCount on the holder: how many transactions this key has sent (67 at the read)
curl -s -X POST https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_getTransactionCount","params":["<holder>","0x18f5995"]}'
independent_read_reproduce.note: read between blocks 26171796 and 26171797 of the chain

cheapest_fix.what: admin power taken away from a bare key

independent_read.disagree: the timelock score says no delay (0), the contract enforces its own timelock of 336 h (timelock())
independent_read.posture: admin: a plain key (EIP-7702: its account runs the code of 0x63c0…e32b), 67 transactions sent; delay: 336 h the contract enforces itself
